Calculation Parameters
Hose-up time and travel buffer used in ETC and schedule generation
Hose-up / Setup Time
6 hrs
Added to every supply operation
Travel Buffer
1 hr
Barge travel between vessels
Overrun Contingency
1 hr
Free Windows & availability margin after each ETC
Formulas in use
ETC = Supply Start + 6h + (Qty ÷ TPH)
Next Start ≥ ETC + 1h travel
Time from barge arrival to supply start (hose connection, safety checks, paperwork)
Sailing time between consecutive vessels
Planning margin after each job's ETC — used by Free Windows and Check Availability, does not change scheduled ETCs

Email Body — Plain Text (Editable)

      
      
      

        
        

          "Download Formatted Email" is the real fix for the bold/color — it builds an actual email file with the formatting baked in. Click it, then open the downloaded file: it launches in your mail app already bold and blue, exactly like the preview above, with To/Subject/Body all filled in — no copy-paste needed. Click Forward or Send from there.
        

      

      

        
        

          "Open in Mail App" below is the quick alternative — it opens your email app instantly with recipient/subject/body filled in, but the body will be plain text (no bold/color) since that's a hard limitation of the mailto: link itself, not something any tool can push formatting through. It also copies the formatted version to your clipboard at the same time, in case you'd rather select-all + paste over the plain body.
